quest.title: Starry Night Chapter
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.text: Ha, friends! How nice to see someone alive in this dump!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Hi, call me Lunja, of The Farrokhzadan, even though technically, I'm a Farrokhdokht, haha! These are my boys...

dialogues.speaker: Minum
dialogues.text: ...Minum.

dialogues.speaker: Ziri
dialogues.text: Ziri.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Very good, very upbeat! As you can see, me and the boys welcome you here. Please help yourself to a hot meal!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Ahem, right, Minum, Ziri?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Ms. Lunja, they don't look very enthusiastic...

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Ahem, show some enthusiasm, boys!

dialogues.speaker: Minum
dialogues.text: *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Ziri
dialogues.text: Welcome, strangers.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: My apologies! They're from the desert and haven't gotten used to the rainforest.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: It's humid and stuffy. You can wring water out of your shirt, pants, and bandana. It's such a mess after every fight...

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: You probably know we have three thousand terms to classify sand, and tens of thousands of ways to deal with it.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: But moisture and plants? I'm out. They make me uncomfortable the whole time, and I feel like I'll never be able to deal with them.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: That's enough of my nagging. Job comes first... And too much complaining hurts morale! After all, life is life, but business is still business, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Hey, {NICKNAME}, Paimon thinks we just ran into a bunch of weirdos.)

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Ahem, excuse me, but I didn't get your names. Where did you come from and what are you doing here?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #Just call me {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's name is Paimon! We're here to...

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Is that so? What could be in this rainforest that is worth risking your lives for?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Haha! You adventurers are such interesting people. May the gale and sand never blind you and may you find what you seek!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: We don't mean to interrupt, boss, but...

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: It's time we get going.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: All right. We've got to run, my friends. Sorry we can't extend our hospitality.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Once we part, you're on your own. Without the desert folk watching your back, you'd better keep an eye out for wild beasts...

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: The savage jungle is just like desert. In the desert, when you leave your tribe, you're on your own. You will be an easy prey for the hungry beasts.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is that a threat?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: A threat? Why would I threaten my friends? It's just a kind reminder! Who do you think I am?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: How irritating... Come, Minum and Ziri, let's go!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: Wait...

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: The pot...!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Just leave it there for our new friends! Let's go!

choices.text: It depends on what we'll find.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Someone sent you? It must be someone of high standing, or at least someone very rich, right?

choices.text: Well... I wouldn't exactly say that.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Is that so...

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: So, if, and I mean if, you're rival bounty hunters, what should I do with you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Freaked you out, didn't I? Minum, Ziri, did you see that? They freaked out!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: ...Yeah.

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: They freaked out, obviously.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, no, not at all! Grow up, people!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Sorry, don't mind that, it was just a joke!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it wasn't funny at all!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Relax. To us Eremites, daring to harm our guests is to court the wrath of the merciless desert.

choices.text: (We should leave as soon as we can.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These guys are weird, so eager to get chummy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'd better be careful.
Yes, yes, you should be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, since you both say so...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!?
Huh!?
Hey! You startled me!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's Paimon's line!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm... Speaking of which, little one, who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Aranakin isn't a "little one," Aranakin is Aranakin!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: You can't listen to those sand grains. They're liars with bad minds who are here for the Aranara!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Bad minds, bad bad minds!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What...? Paimon didn't get that at all...

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: White Floaty is silly, so White Floaty didn't get it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wha— Hey!

choices.text: He's talking about those people from just now.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} smart, that's what Aranakin means.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You know our names?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: #Aranakin smart. When you talked to them, I listened. I heard that Nara's name is "{NICKNAME}" and that your name is "Paimon."

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: But Floaty Paimon is silly and doesn't understand Aranakin.

choices.text: Floaty Paimon is like that, it's true.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Paimon's not silly!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: First, we need to find Zohrah Mushroom. Zohrah Mushroom, is little shiny spots, just like my songs!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: But to find Zohrah Mushroom, you need "Kusava."

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Um, that's fine. You guys are great. Aranakin can entrust Kusava to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... it comes again, things Paimon can't understand. Kusawan? What is that?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Fatty fruit, bitter fruit. Temporary home of Aranara memories. Kusava makes Aranara strong.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Mawtiyima is feeling sick, Marana is getting bigger. We must go quickly. Quickly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait a second, we don't even know where we're going!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Zohrah Mushroom! We need Zohrah Mushroom, to prepare Arahaoma. We need Arahaoma, to help Mawtiyima be lively again!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: I know where Zohrah Mushroom is, I take you there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright... Hey, wait for us!

choices.text: Is there something we can do for you?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Yes, something very important! So very important! Mawtiyima is in great danger, the grass and trees in the forest... Everyone is worried! She asked us to find you. We waited for so long.

choices.text: They must have some sort of a scheme.
What are the "sand grains" you are talking about?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Sand is Valuka, and those sand grains are a group of bad Nara Valuka. I don't like sand, it's coarse, rough, and irritating. And it gets everywhere...

talks.objective: Use the Kusava to open up the path

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #Aranakin's right to trust you. Nara {NICKNAME} is no sand grain but a mighty seed! Aranakin must sing about it and let everyone in the woods know!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Yay~ Kusava~ Kusava~♪

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cool~seek~wan~♪

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ko~se~han~♪

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Ku! Sa! Va! Happy!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Aranakin is going to the Mawtiyima Forest and meet up with friends. You must come see us and join the ritual coming up!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #Over here, Nara {NICKNAME}, Floaty Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's water everywhere. That "Zohrah Mushroom" you mentioned... Is it really here?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Here, underwater. Rocks and vines protect and cover him, so he's safe in water.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Rocks blessed by Nara Varuna broke apart by themselves after many many moonsets.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Broken rocks sealed off the path to Zohrah Mushroom and protected him.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Aranakin can repair the rocks and make the water leave, so we can find Zohrah Mushroom.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Use the Kusava to summon Aranakin's power. Aranakin... trusts you will treat the Kusava well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course. We'll cherish anything you entrust us with!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: *humming* Kusava~ Kusava~♪

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cool~seek~wan~♪

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Wow, that was terrible.

choices.text: Why the singing all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Aranakin sings happy songs because there's hope for Mawtiyima, because Nara is willing to help!

talks.objective: Lower the water level in the cave

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this the Zohrah Mushroom? It looks so... mundane.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Mm, this is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: It is just an ordinary mushroom, very cunning. Very clever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? So we wasted all that effort?

choices.text: But where is the Zohrah Mushroom?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Zohrah Mushroom is no ordinary mushroom, thus more cunning and clever. He's probably escaped by now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Mushrooms can run away too?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: #Of course! They don't have roots but can absorb nutrients in rocks. They don't have legs but can run, for they are mushrooms, not plants! But don't fret, Nara {NICKNAME}, let me ask this fellow.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Aranakin and the mushroom speak in whispers.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: It said, Zohrah Mushroom went to a cave that has Marana, which has dissolved in the water. It's very dangerous.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But why would the Zohrah Mushroom go there?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Because Marana moves too fast and must be stopped. Zohrah Mushroom can stop Marana, but won't hold up for long.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm... Then we better get going and save the mushroom!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Yes, we must hurry!

choices.text: Is the Zohrah Mushroom not here?

talks.objective: Go to the exit of the cave

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, friend Aragaru is waiting for you too. I'll tell the plants along the way to inform him that you're coming.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: He'll be waiting for you in the cave where the moon falls. He'll guide you to the dead Nara's old home. The walking Shroom-Kin now live there. Be careful.

talks.objective: Use the Kusava to open up the path
Go to the cave where the Zohrah Mushroom is located
Talk to the people who are blocking the cave

dialogues.speaker: Minum
dialogues.text: Stop.

dialogues.speaker: Ziri
dialogues.text: You can't enter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are you people here again? Come on! What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, you can't even come up with an answer, that's so suspicious!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: You can't enter.

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: You can't enter, and that's that.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: ...It's three. Three at least.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Pardon my boys, they're not good with words. I've already made it clear that I'd never threaten friends. It was just a warning, that's all.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Whatever you want is not in this cave, unless it's death. Everything dies in there, no matter what it is.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't try to scare us. We've experienced all kinds of danger!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Why would I try to scare you when I'm elated to see you again? I'm just worried about your safety.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: We discovered a Withering Zone inside. That's why we've drawn a circle at the entrance to warn commoners from wandering in.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Where's the circle then?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Where's the circle?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Tell me now, where's the circle!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: I, uh, he, uh...

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: You're the boss, so there's one if you say so.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Ahem. Regardless, my friends, the cave is treacherous and unpredictable. I suggest you leave right now.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: "Again"? Well, I guess fate works in mysterious ways. It's got plans for us.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Alright, alright... Don't listen to me, then. Like I said, I warned you out of the goodness of my heart. Go in if you insist... It's not like you're hiring us to be your bodyguards, right?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Come on, boys. We're out of here.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Ahem, let's go!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: That's what we all thought when we picked up our first sword! Until we saw blood for the first time.

choices.text: You two think you can stop me?

talks.objective: Go into the cave where the Zohrah Mushroom is located

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #I'm here! Nara {NICKNAME}, and White Floaty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, where have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Some bad "sand grains" were here. They were up to no good, so I didn't want to come out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you referring to those Eremite mercenaries? Are you afraid of them?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: White Floaty wrong! I'm not afraid! They're weak, I'm strong!

choices.text: Strong to the point of hiding?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: #No, no! Hmph! Nara {NICKNAME} only says irritating things!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, the water here... It's showing some strange colors. Do you think it's because of...

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Correct, it is Marana. It permeates the water and dances like mist... So you can't drink the water, and it makes the plants sick.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Thanks to Zohrah Mushroom, Marana has withdrawn a little. But Marana is still too much around. Zohrah Mushroom is not feeling well. He's in danger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But the place is all affected by The Withering. How are we supposed to get close?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Hmm... Look at that odd old rock over there! Repair it and the crack in the pond should open big enough... to drain the water away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... even if we can drain the water, what are we going to do with The Withering here?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Well... We'll worry about that later! We also have to break the seal protecting Zohrah Mushroom to let him join us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, got it. Let's get to work then!

choices.text: We have to be careful from now on.

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is right. Be careful of those bad "sand grains" and their wicked thoughts.

talks.objective: Lower the water level in the cave

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll bear that in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Oh, and... Uh, don't go yet...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Aranakin loves to sing and share songs with friends. But Aranakin doesn't know if Nara could hear Aranara's songs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, we can! Paimon loves to sing too!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Then Aranakin will give you this song. Please take the songleaf. Follow its veins with Nara's voice and the song will come out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you mean that, uh, we can follow the score and learn your song?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Yes, yes! Paimon the White Floaty can be smart sometimes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, that probably came out wrong, but thanks!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Yes, together!

choices.text: We can sing it together sometime.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Hmm... It's sealed. We need to look around for the stones that can lift the seal. Use the Kusava!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, nothing comes easy...

talks.objective: Drain the water and obtain the Zohrah Mushroom
Use the Kusava to break the seal on the Zohrah Mushroom

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's hear your offer first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you serious about doing business with her?

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Minum, Ziri, I got it! Find a messenger to inform the client! And we're leaving now!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Those were tough opponents. The Withering couldn't stop them, Anqa and Isan got hurt too. So before they catch up with us...

dialogues.speaker: Minum
dialogues.text: Boss...

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Didn't you hear what I said? What are you waiting for?

dialogues.speaker: Ziri
dialogues.text: #{M#He}{F#She} is here already.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: *sigh* I just can't get rid of you, can I...

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Sorry, my "friends," we just wanted the Zohrah Mushroom for our client. Just business, nothing personal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Friends? We're not friends! How can you still call us that?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: What do you mean, little one? I already apologized. Let's just let bygones be bygones, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaahh!! You...!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Seriously, you've proven you're extraordinary by giving Anqa and Isan a good thrashing.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: I admire warriors like you. It's my honor to be your friend. But... business is business. I'm sure you understand, right? I hate to break our friendship.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: It would be such a shame to let some boring business get in between us friends!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Take it easy, my friend. You're the ones who are cornered in this cave. You wanna risk your life for it? Not a problem.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: But I'd rather not see more of my people get hurt over a lousy mushroom. The pay's just not worth it. So, let's make a deal...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who would trust a scammer like you?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Well, that depends on how much you're willing to pay.

choices.text: Is this how you treat your "friends"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Zohrah Mushroom is gone! Look, over there...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: The awful "sand grains"! Follow them!

talks.objective: Get the Zohrah Mushroom back from Lunja

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We need it to save the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Giving you guys a good thrashing seems to be the better deal here.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Ha! Is that the so-called buyer's pride? I like it!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Take everything valuable from them!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Because that's how I like it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But I don't have that much Mora on me right now.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Sorry, no IOU! Perhaps you can give me that squawking flying pet of yours as collateral?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? Don't do that!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: You're kinda cute when you bargain. I'm listening.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Give me the mushroom and I promise you'll get your money later.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: I didn't think a promise could be worth that much. But what are you going to do if I don't believe you?

choices.text: Minum's kneecaps look brittle to me.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Don't be full of yourself. They're The Farrokhzadan and also my boys.

choices.text: I've already taken down two of you. What's a few more?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Hmph... Interesting offer you have there. I'll believe you... this time. Let's go, boys.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Not so fast.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Why? You changed your mind?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm pondering how you're going to compensate us.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Interesting. And why would we do that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Because you laid the trap and tricked us! Plus... ahem, Ziri's nose, Minum's kneecaps, Anqa and Isan's injuries...

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Tsk, name your price.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right, Mora!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Got to be valuable, at least!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: I see. If this would prevent my boys from getting hurt...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you should've seen it coming!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: ...That's not a good way to do business. Agha Farrokh will never forget your offense, and you will get it when the table is turned.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Let's go, boys, and remember their faces!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Final advice: Keep one eye open when you sleep at night. Don't forget, my "friends," you haven't paid for what you bought yet.

choices.text: It's more sincere when it's something precious.
Now just think about how much Mora you will lose if you tick me off.
It will be interesting to see how I smash Ziri's nose in.
How much more do you think you can afford Anqa and Isan's medical bills?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These guys are weird, so eager to get chummy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'd better be careful.
Yes, yes, you should be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon

Huh!?
Hey! You startled me!!

dialogues.text: That's Paimon's line!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin

response.speaker: Paimon

response.speaker: Aranakin

response.text: Wha— Hey!

response.text: Mawtiyima is feeling sick, Marana is getting bigger. We must go quickly. Quickly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait a second, we don't even know where we're going!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Zohrah Mushroom! We need Zohrah Mushroom, to prepare Arahaoma. We need Arahaoma, to help Mawtiyima be lively again!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: I know where Zohrah Mushroom is, I take you there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright... Hey, wait for us!

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: I know. All the grass and trees, one by one, were passing the message, and it got to me. So I knew I would see you here!

choices.text: They must have some sort of a scheme.
What are the "sand grains" you are talking about?

response.speaker: Aranakin
response.text: Sand is Valuka, and those sand grains are a group of bad Nara Valuka. I don't like sand, it's coarse, rough, and irritating. And it gets everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're gone... They better not try to scam us again next time. Anyway, we got the Zohrah Mushroom!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #The bad "sand grains" are terrifying, but Nara {NICKNAME} is even more so sometimes... Scaring people away with strange words.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, yeah, {NICKNAME} is like that sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you picked on the wrong person! The Zohrah Mushroom is ours now!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: #Impressive! Nara {NICKNAME} made those bad "sand grains" run off in a couple of moves! Pow! Smash!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That's super fighter Nara {NICKNAME} for you!

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Speaking of the Mawtiyima Forest, Aranaga is waiting for you there. He presides over the Arahaoma ritual. Go see him!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Ready for combat) I can offer you a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, you're extorting the wrong people!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: I see. I respect your proposal.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Hmph... Your tenacity is so infuriating! We're deep in the red for this one! All right, boys, get ready to fight!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: I'll make it short, then. A rich old man in the Akademiya hired us, the Eremites, to find the Zohrah Mushroom in the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: The pay's very good, but the deadline's very tight. And as you can see, a young and charming woman like me really needed Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: You know the rest. Sorry for using you to get this Zo... and almost killing... Uh, almost stopping you from pursuing me.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: But since you're alive and kicking, we'll still be friends and let bygones be bygones, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No! That's attempted murder. Let bygones be bygones!? Someone could have gotten killed!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Well, that's exactly what I'm worried about. They're all my family. I don't want to endanger anyone, or it's a bad deal.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Therefore, it seems that a peaceful resolution is the way to go. But what do you want the mushroom for, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Ready for combat) Your losses aren't my problem.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: ...Don't want to do business, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: *sigh* Get them, boys!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Hmph... That old man did mention the Zohrah Mushroom is the key to eradicating The Withering, and that was why he wanted us to get it at all cost.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: But it ain't anything valuable, and The Withering in these blasted woods have nothing to do with us desert dwellers.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: The intrinsic value of the mushroom, plus labor, medical expenses for Anqa and Isan, fines for breach of contract, and... a little extra to compensate a friend.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: That comes out to 450,000 Mora and not a penny less. How's that? You're getting off cheap.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? That's robbery!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: 500,000 Mora for calling me a robber and hurting my feelings! We're traders, so watch your words.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I accept your offer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Haha, all right! 550,000 Mora it is!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the heck!?
Ha, friends! How nice to see someone alive in this dump!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Hi, call me Lunja, of The Farrokhzadan, even though technically, I'm a Farrokhdokht, haha! These are my boys...

dialogues.speaker: Minum
dialogues.text: ...Minum.

dialogues.speaker: Ziri
dialogues.text: Ziri.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Very good, very upbeat! As you can see, me and the boys welcome you here. Please help yourself to a hot meal!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Ahem, right, Minum, Ziri?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Ms. Lunja, they don't look very enthusiastic...

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Ahem, show some enthusiasm, boys!

dialogues.speaker: Minum
dialogues.text: *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Ziri
dialogues.text: Welcome, strangers.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: My apologies! They're from the desert and haven't gotten used to the rainforest.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: It's humid and stuffy. You can wring water out of your shirt, pants, and bandana. It's such a mess after every fight...

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: You probably know we have three thousand terms to classify sand, and tens of thousands of ways to deal with it.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: But moisture and plants? I'm out. They make me uncomfortable the whole time, and I feel like I'll never be able to deal with them.

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: That's enough of my nagging. Job comes first... And too much complaining hurts morale! After all, life is life, but business is still business, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Hey, {NICKNAME}, Paimon thinks we just ran into a bunch of weirdos.)

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Ahem, excuse me, but I didn't get your names. Where did you come from and what are you doing here?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #Just call me {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's name is Paimon! Ara...

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Ara...?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Is that so? What could be in this rainforest that is worth risking your lives for?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Haha! You adventurers are such interesting people. May the gale and sand never blind you and may you find what you seek!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: We don't mean to interrupt, boss, but...

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: It's time we get going.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: All right. We've got to run, my friends. Sorry we can't extend our hospitality.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Once we part, you're on your own. Without the desert folk watching your back, you'd better keep an eye out for wild beasts...

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: The savage jungle is just like desert. In the desert, when you leave your tribe, you're on your own. You will be an easy prey for the hungry beasts.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is that a threat?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: A threat? Why would I threaten my friends? It's just a kind reminder! Who do you think I am?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: How irritating... Come, Minum and Ziri, let's go!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: Wait...

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: The pot...!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Just leave it there for our new friends! Let's go!

choices.text: It depends on what we'll find.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Someone sent you? It must be someone of high standing, or at least someone very rich, right?

choices.text: Well... I wouldn't exactly say that.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Is that so...

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: So, if, and I mean if, you're rival bounty hunters, what should I do with you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Freaked you out, didn't I? Minum, Ziri, did you see that? They freaked out!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: ...Yeah.

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: They freaked out, obviously.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, no, not at all! Grow up, people!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Sorry, don't mind that, it was just a joke!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, it wasn't funny at all!

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Relax. To us Eremites, daring to harm our guests is to court the wrath of the merciless desert.

choices.text: (We should leave as soon as we can.)

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Come, my friends, sit down and have some tea! So, did whatever it was in the cave scare you away?

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: Haha, it's fine, really! You're still alive, aren't you? Nothing matters more than that. Some things you just have to let go.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: Is that so? That's great. Minum, Ziri, you guys heard that? Let's make a toast to this great adventurer!

response.speaker: Minum
response.text: To courage...

response.speaker: Ziri
response.text: To health.

response.speaker: Lunja
response.text: To the bleak paths ahead and the treacherous exits to come! Cheers!

dialogues.speaker: Lunja
dialogues.text: You're our guests. Make yourselves at home.

dialogues.speaker: Ziri
dialogues.text: Be careful in the cave.
Ha, friends! How nice to see someone alive in this dump!
